answer: An agent fleet tracking glacier runoff, raven roosts, and shale quarries mitigates Sybil attacks using remote hardware attestation. Each participant must generate keys inside a certified secure enclave that signs a verifiable silicon identity measurement. An attacker incurs the scarce physical cost of procuring distinct secure hardware chips per forged identity. However, this dependence creates vendor lock-in and breaks when architectural side-channel exploits leak enclave signing keys.
